error: Something went wrong. Check the local engine and try again.
emptyIntro: Open a Meet, Zoom, or Teams call, then start capture from the WatchNT extension popup.
deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting and its local data?
title: Meeting title
pending: This section is still being prepared.
sectionFailed: This section could not be generated. You can retry extraction.
ask: Ask a question about this meeting
privacy: Audio and storage stay on this device. Only text goes to a cloud AI provider when you explicitly allow it.
setupIntro: Connect a local model or bring your own key. There is no required subscription.
speechHelp: Multilingual Whisper base · CPU int8 · voice activity detection. Existing weights are reused; no automatic downloads.
consent: I allow meeting text to be sent to my selected cloud AI provider for extraction and meeting questions.
consentNeeded: Allow cloud text processing or choose Ollama to keep everything local.
recoverHelp: A previous recording ended before it was saved. Save the retained transcript to its meeting.
startHint: Start audio capture from the WatchNT toolbar popup.
noAudio: If microphone permission is unavailable, only meeting tab audio is captured.
recordingHint: Live preview updates in approximately 8-second windows.
aiReview: AI notes may contain errors. Review decisions and assignments against the transcript.
captionHelp: Enable captions in your meeting first. Speaker names depend on the meeting platform.
deleteHelp: This permanently removes the meeting and its local files. This cannot be undone.
noTaskHelp: Tasks extracted from your meetings will appear here.
openMeetingHint: Open a Meet, Zoom, or Teams call to start.
engineOfflineHint: Backend unavailable. Open Settings for startup instructions.
stopHint: Your transcript will be saved before analysis begins.
modelHint: Use the exact model name available in your provider.
keyHint: Stored locally. Existing keys stay masked.
chatDescription: Ask about decisions, commitments, or anything in this transcript.
saveFirst: Save your settings to apply these changes.
backendInstructions: Run these commands from the WatchNT repository, then try again.
backendUnavailable: Cannot connect to the backend at localhost:8000. Start it and try again.
requestTimeout: The backend did not respond in time. Try again.
processingSaved: Transcript saved. Notes are processing; you can open the meeting now.
captureFailedHelp: Open the meeting to check its transcript and error details.
captureSavedHelp: Your transcript and notes are available in the meeting.
setupDescription: Connect the backend, configure capture, and test your AI provider.
setupBackendHelp: WatchNT needs its local Python backend for storage and transcription. Loading the extension alone does not start it.
setupInstallHelp: Run this from the repository with Python installed. Use your existing virtual environment if you have one.
setupMicrophoneHelp: Enable microphone access to include your voice. You can continue without it, but audio capture will include only the meeting tab. Captions require captions to be enabled in the call.
setupProviderHelp: Choose a provider below. Setup finishes only after both local transcription and the selected AI model pass their connection tests.
setupModelsHelp: If Whisper is missing, this command explicitly downloads the multilingual base model (about 150 MB). Setup never downloads models automatically.
setupOllamaHelp: For Ollama, start the service if needed, then use a model name from ollama list. If no models are installed, install a model through Ollama first; model downloads can be several GB. Cloud providers require your API key and explicit text-processing consent below.
setupReadyHelp: The backend, speech model, and AI provider passed their checks.
setupPin: Pin WatchNT from the browser Extensions menu.
setupCall: Join a Meet, Zoom, or Teams call. The amber toolbar reminder indicates a detected call.
setupPreview: Open WatchNT and start capture. Check that speech appears in the live preview; red REC indicates recording.
setupStop: Stop and save, then select Open meeting to view the transcript and processing status.
